extraction.name: LongBench: A Bilingual, Multitask Benchmark for Long Context Understanding
extraction.description: A bilingual, multi-task benchmark for evaluating long context understanding in large language models, covering 21 datasets across 6 task categories in English and Chinese.
extraction.creator: Yushi Bai, Xin Lv, Jiajie Zhang, Hongchang Lyu, Jiankai Tang, Zhidian Huang, Zhengxiao Du, Xiao Liu, Aohan Zeng, Lei Hou, Yuxiao Dong, Jie Tang, Juanzi Li
extraction.rai:dataCollection: LongBench was constructed from 21 datasets. Six datasets were directly extracted from original datasets, 10 were built from original datasets and processed for long-context evaluation, and 5 were created and annotated by the authors. For public datasets, data were extracted from test sets to avoid test leakage, using random sampling and uniform sampling. For MultiFieldQA, documents were manually collected from multiple sources and annotated by Ph.D. students. For some tasks, contexts were constructed by sampling and concatenating passages, documents, or examples.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionType: Secondary Data analysis, Manual Human Curator, Experiments
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Original datasets and sources include NarrativeQA, Qasper, HotpotQA, 2WikiMultihopQA, MuSiQue, DuReader, GovReport, QMSum, MultiNews, VCSUM, TREC, TriviaQA, SAMSum, LSHT, PassageCount, PassageRetrieval-en, PassageRetrieval-zh, LCC, RepoBench-P, plus manually collected documents from legal documents, government reports, encyclopedias, academic papers, Wikipedia, Baidu Search/Baidu Zhidao, GitHub, and C4.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Contexts were standardized into a unified format. For multi-document QA, supporting passages were included and additional distracting passages were added until a maximum length was reached, then randomly ordered. For few-shot tasks, a random number of training examples was sampled and concatenated as context. For synthetic tasks, passages were sampled, duplicated, shuffled, and summarized as specified. For code completion, cross-file snippets were retrieved, shuffled, and concatenated with in-file context.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Public datasets were taken from test sets to avoid leakage. Some datasets were filtered or adapted for long-context evaluation, including selecting longer documents, filtering TriviaQA passages shorter than 1,000 words, selecting long segments from VCSUM, and using only the most challenging RepoBench-P setting. LongBench-E was created by uniform sampling across length ranges.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Five datasets were created and annotated by the authors. For MultiFieldQA, three Ph.D. students annotated one question and one groundtruth answer per document, with requirements that questions be clear, answers definitive and relatively short, and evidence distributed randomly across the article. For MuSiQue, annotators paraphrased questions. For HotpotQA, questions were directly written by native speakers. For PassageRetrieval tasks, GPT-3.5-Turbo was used to generate summaries for passages.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: Cross-validation among annotators for MultiFieldQA showed a 100% accuracy rate of the annotated answers. The paper also notes that definitive answers were preferred for ease of automated evaluation.
extraction.rai:annotationsPerItem: 1 question and 1 groundtruth answer per document for MultiFieldQA; other annotation counts are not explicitly stated.
extraction.rai:annotatorDemographics: Three Ph.D. students with extensive research experience in NLP; native speakers are mentioned for some HotpotQA questions, but no further demographics are given.
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: GPT-3.5-Turbo was used to generate summaries for PassageRetrieval-en and PassageRetrieval-zh.
extraction.rai:personalSensitiveInformation: Language, geography, age, experience, and domain-specific content may be present in the benchmark tasks and source datasets; no explicit sensitive attributes are described as collected.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The benchmark is intended to facilitate research on long-context understanding in LLMs and improve evaluation of models on realistic long-text tasks.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The authors note potential biases from evidence placement in MultiFieldQA and intentionally randomize evidence positions to avoid beginning/end bias. They also note higher correlations among tasks in the same language and that some datasets, especially Wikipedia-derived ones, may be susceptible to memorization.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: Automatic metrics such as ROUGE-L and F1 may not accurately reflect response quality, especially for longer responses. Performance is coupled with instruction-following ability. Some tasks may be influenced by memorization because models may have seen similar long contexts during pretraining.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Benchmarking and evaluation of long-context understanding for LLMs, including zero-shot evaluation and few-shot evaluation for few-shot tasks; LongBench-E is used to assess performance across different context lengths.
